title: Concept: Kafdrop console is reachable without authentication
description: Kafdrop is a read-mostly view over a Kafka cluster but it also exposes topic administration, and its message browser renders raw payloads. A public instance therefore publishes the event stream and the topic layout in one page.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads message contents, learns the topic schema, and can delete or create topics where the cluster ACLs allow it.
